correctness.rationale: For Q_n, U and V are unions of n cones on the facets of opposite simplex boundaries; each retracts onto S^(n-2), and their exact intersection is the crown graph. For n=3 six triangular facets collapse to the C6 graph. For n>=4 the two graph inclusions are nullhomotopic in simply connected U,V, so homotopy pushout yields two S^(n-2) spheres and n^2-3n+1 S2 spheres. Natural integral Mayer–Vietoris provides H2=H1(Q_n) twisted by side swap and top module sgn⊗side permutation for n>=5. Directed cycle-lattice traces yield f^2-3f+1 and 2t-1. Independently recomputed the mod-two Betti numbers for n=3,4,5,6 by constructing closed-neighborhood faces and exact F2 boundary ranks; all agree.
